newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ares-Serono to take 99 pct of Interpharm.
newsitem.headline: Ares-Serono to take 99 pct of Interpharm.

text.p: Ares-Serono S.A., the Swiss pharmaceuticals firm based in Geneva, said that it had acquired a 99-percent stake in InterPharm Laboratories Ltd, based in Ness-Ziona, Isreal.
It said the acquisition followed completion of settlement of pending class action securities litigation involving a minority shareholder in the case "Skydell versus Ares-Serono."

"Pursuant to the terms of the order of settlement issued by the U.S. District Court, Ares-Serono has received applications (from current shareholders) to sell for 610,662 shares of Interpharm Laboratories Ltd which Ares-Serono has agreed to acquire," Ares-Serono said in a press statement.
A spokeswoman for Ares-Serono said the agreement called for Ares-Serono to pay a uniform price of $25.00 per share in the agreement.
The agreement, allowing the Swiss firm to purchase effectively all of Interpharm, reflected the fact that the minority shareholders involved in the litigation had also agreed to sell their stake.
The litigation dates back to Ares-Serono's 1994 tender offer for shares of Interpharm at $22.00.
According to the spokeswoman, the terms of the latest offer were to go ahead if the shares offered to Ares-Serono exceeded 600,000.
Another spokesman for the firm also said that Interpharm was founded by Ares-Serono in 1978, but the Swiss company reduced its 100 percent stake to 75 percent in connection with a capital increase.
